_comment: AI_CONTEXT example hooks. Merge the 'hooks' block into your .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (global). These are EXAMPLES — adjust commands to your stack. Prefer the /hooks command or the update-config skill to edit safely.

_patterns.auto-format: PostToolUse on Edit/Write keeps code tidy automatically.
_patterns.secret-guard: Add a Stop or PreToolUse hook that runs your secret scanner (betterleaks/gitleaks) and fails if it finds something.
_patterns.env-guard: A PreToolUse hook can inspect the tool input and block edits to .env / secrets by exiting non-zero. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks

hooks.command: echo [project] Loaded. Plan first for non-trivial changes; run /security-review before shipping.
